tasks.DefineProblem: Understand the problem statement and requirements for finding the maximum length of a subsequence with differences between adjacent elements in an array.
tasks.GenerateFunctionSignature: Create a function signature that takes an array and its size as input, and returns the maximum length of such a subsequence.
tasks.ImplementAlgorithm: Develop an algorithm to solve the defined problem.
tasks.TestFunction: Verify the correctness of the implemented function using provided test cases.
tasks.WriteCode: Translate the developed algorithm into code following best practices for the specified programming language.
